# How many places write a user-facing string that another file also writes.
#
# A caption, a status name, a button - each belongs to the type that owns the
# concept, asked for as TestStatus.getLabel() or
# TestRunConfiguration.getDisplayName(). A second file spelling it out is a
# divergence nothing fails over: both read correctly alone, and they stop
# agreeing the day one is renamed.
#
# tools/inspect.ps1 counts every place after the first, so this is "how many
# places should be asking an owner instead". inspect.yml fails when it goes up
# and says so when it goes down - update the number then, so the ratchet keeps
# its meaning.
#
# 304 when the check was written. The four report generators had already been
# fixed by then: they spelled out Passed, Failed, Blocked, Untested and Removed
# seventeen times between them, and now ask TestStatus.
#
# 278 after StatusBarShortcut gained cancel() and confirm(). Twenty-one dialogs
# declared Escape/"Cancel"/closeCancel identically and seven declared
# Enter/"Confirm"/submit, which was the largest cluster in the plugin.
#
# 262 after Priority, Group and Description started coming from
# TestEditorAttributes, which owns what a test case's fields are called.
#
# 246 after the rest followed: every caption the create dialog, the update
# dialog and the run grid share with a test case attribute now asks for it.
#
# 195 after the node names, the report headings, the two Git comparators and
# the verdict words followed the same route. Two that could not: NodeCount
# cannot ask DirectoryType for a node's name, because DirectoryType names its
# counts and the two would initialize each other.
#
# 191 after Done gave the past-tense notification vocabulary an owner. That one
# is worth less to the count than to the rule: CLAUDE.md has always said a
# confirmation is the outcome in the past tense and nothing else, and until Done
# there was nothing to say it to.
#
# 186 after the four verbs the Done migration missed - they went through a
# helper and a ternary rather than straight to softShow - and the two bug
# captions in the failed-result dialog.
#
# 182 after the Git conflict offer got one owner. Two routes raised the same
# balloon with the same title and the same three captions - "Git Conflicts",
# "Resolve", "Continue rebase", "Abort rebase" - and the middle button did
# different things depending on which of them the tester was looking at. The
# four strings are the smaller half of that finding (#158, item 9).
#
# Seven of what is left is machinery the filter cannot tell from a caption: a
# font name and a date locale look exactly like one. They are a floor on this
# number rather than work to do.
#
# 169 after the status bar work. The editor's own clock went - two labels wrote
# the same corner with different meanings - and the flat hover button moved out
# of the toolbar package to be shared with the status bar's page arrows, which
# took its captions with it. The filter sets stopped being spelled out three
# times over.
#
# 166 after the badge work. A priority badge asks Priority for its label
# instead of spelling one, and the two bug captions became one badge with one
# caption. Counted rather than attributed: the check reports places, not which
# three of them stopped writing a string somebody else already wrote.
#
# 148 after light mode (#13), which is the largest single drop since the check
# was written and almost none of it was aimed at this number. A window that shows
# the same test case, offers the same verdicts and asks for the same failure
# details as the run editor had every chance to spell all of it out a second
# time, and the rule against that is what kept it from happening:
#
#   FailureFields    the four failure captions, their defaults and their wording,
#                    declared once and filled in twice - the run editor's dialog
#                    and light mode's own form
#   Toolbar          START_MANUAL_EXECUTION and a new STOP_EXECUTION, so the
#                    window's execution buttons read the toolbar's words instead
#                    of inventing their own pair
#   Display          numberedStep, so the details panel and light mode number a
#                    step the same way
#   Keycap           the look of a printed key, which is where 28 dialogs and
#                    light mode's verdict buttons now agree
#
# Two of it came from deleting rather than sharing. Cancel and Save & next left
# the failure form once Enter and Escape were found to be enough, and each of
# those words had been written twice - on the button and again in the status bar
# hint beside it. The expected result left the view menu for the same kind of
# reason and took its caption with it.
#
# Counted rather than attributed, as above.
#
# 156 on 9 September, the first time the ratchet has gone up. Six clusters, all
# from that one day. Finding them meant running the check at the commit that
# recorded 148 and diffing its findings against the current ones - the count
# alone says how many, never which.
#
# 144 after three of the six. Fields moved to AbstractDetailsPopupBtn, passed by
# each subclass rather than fixed in the parent, because a third caller
# deliberately says something else. Export and Import became ExportAction.NAME
# and ImportAction.NAME, so a dialog reads the gesture it performs instead of
# spelling it - which took the button and the Enter hint inside each dialog with
# it. Save became StatusBarShortcut.save() and SAVE, the same move cancel() and
# confirm() made at 304: six files wrote that word and one does now.
#
# The other three were left, and the reasons are worth more than the count.
# "Created" and "Updated" are three concepts sharing a spelling - a
# notification, a run status, a row caption - so one owner would mean renaming a
# status renames a balloon; a fourth site is a javadoc the filter cannot tell
# from a caption. "test cases" and "test runs" are the circular initialization
# this file already records. "Navigate to Code" is written on opposite sides of
# the leaf rule: Automated is in model, CardHoverAction is in editor, and model
# may not import editor.
144
